description: Fuel Hazard Management Units is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. This layer represents polygon boundaries that define the Fuel Hazard Management Units to calculate compliance with the 'Fuel Hazard in Fire Management Zones' provisions of the Code of Practice for Timber Production 2014 (as amended from time to time) (the Code). Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Biota, Farming, Geoscientific information. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
